*Vegan and gluten-as-written [ragi-koozh-05::structure::3].*

* Ragi (finger millet) flour: 300g [ragi-koozh-05::structure::1]

* Water: 1500g [ragi-koozh-05::structure::1]
* Rock salt: 12g [ragi-koozh-05::structure::1]
